value.name: Rosa clarifies pastry intent
value.description: Rosa explains that she brought the pastries as a person who likes pastries, not in her role as housekeeper.
evidence: "his morning, which I did not bring as the housekeeper. I brought them as a person who likes pastries. I want to be clear about that before you eat one."

value.name: Asha accepts pastry terms
value.description: Asha agrees to eat a pastry under Rosa's stated personal terms.
evidence: "I will eat one on those terms," Asha said.

value.name: Asha enters the house
value.description: Asha crosses the threshold into the house, entering the warm, coffee-scented interior.
evidence: The house smelled of coffee and of the pastries Rosa had not brought as the housekeeper and of the faint underlying smell of old wood and old wallpaper and the lavender sachets Mrs. Serrano had kept in the linen closet for forty years and that someone, presumably Lucia, had been replacing as needed.

value.name: Asha notices the prepared dining room
value.description: Asha observes that Daniel and Lucia are seated together, the table is set for four, and a place has been prepared for her at the head of the table.
evidence: In the dining room Daniel and Lucia were sitting on the same side of the table, which they had not done before.
They stood when she came in, which they had also not done before.

The table was set for four, with the pastries on a plate in the middle and a fresh pot of coffee and four cups, and there were yellow pads at each place and pens, and at the head of the table, which was the place Asha had not previously sat in, a chair had been pulled out for her.

value.name: Asha sets down her bag
value.description: Asha places her bag down before joining the others at the table.

value.name: Asha greets the group
value.description: Asha says good morning to Daniel and Lucia as she arrives at the table.

value.name: They greet in unison and laugh
value.description: Asha, Daniel, and Lucia all say good morning almost together, then briefly laugh at the coincidence.
evidence: "Good morning," they said, all three of them, almost in unison, and then laughed, briefly, at the unison.
